policy: Corrections, clarifications, material updates, and retractions belong to the article record and are folded into the public correction register.
A correction must state what changed, when it was corrected, and which publication surfaces require propagation.
Correction propagation should include body copy, headlines when needed, article metadata, social cards, feeds, sitemaps, JSON-LD, and syndication packets.
constraints: Generated from public article frontmatter only.
The register records publication accountability, not reader behavior.
Empty register means no article currently declares a correction record; it is not proof that no future correction will be needed.
